CustomField.label: Controlling Logic
CustomField.description: Logical release condition using task numbers (the number shown in brackets in the Controlling Task list). Examples: 1 OR 2 | 2 AND 3 | (1 OR 2) AND 4. When filled, the task is created only when the condition becomes true. Use either Controlling Task or Controlling Logic, not both.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Task numbers combined with AND / OR and brackets, e.g. 1 OR 2, or (1 OR 2) AND 4. The task is created only when the condition is met.
